title: Grade 6 Math — Mon, Jun 09
description: Basic Geometry — Day 1 of 5: Types of lines and line segments
subject: mathematics

questions.question: Which of these has no endpoints and extends in both directions forever?
questions.explanation: A line has no endpoints and extends infinitely in both directions.

questions.question: A line segment has ___.
questions.explanation: A line segment has two endpoints — it has a fixed, measurable length.

questions.question: A ray has ___.
options: One endpoint and goes on forever in one direction
questions.explanation: A ray has one starting endpoint and extends infinitely in one direction.

questions.question: The edge of a ruler is an example of a ___.
questions.explanation: The edge of a ruler has two ends — it is a line segment.

questions.question: Two lines that never meet (always the same distance apart) are called ___.
questions.explanation: Parallel lines run side by side and never intersect. Train tracks are an example.

questions.question: Two lines that cross each other are called ___.
questions.explanation: Intersecting lines are lines that meet or cross at a point.

questions.question: A sunbeam coming from the sun is best described as a ___.
questions.explanation: A sunbeam starts at the sun (one endpoint) and travels on in one direction — a ray.

questions.question: Which symbol represents a line passing through points A and B?
questions.explanation: A line through A and B is written with arrows on both ends (↔) showing it extends in both directions.

questions.question: How many lines can pass through TWO given points?
questions.explanation: Through any two given points, exactly one straight line can be drawn.

questions.question: Lines that meet at a right angle (90°) are called ___.
The edges of a square are ___.
questions.explanation: The sides of a square are straight and have fixed endpoints — they are line segments.

questions.question: Collinear points are ___.
questions.explanation: Collinear points all lie on the same straight line.

questions.question: Which has the greater length — a line or a line segment?
questions.explanation: A line is infinite (no end). A line segment has a fixed finite length. A line is infinitely longer.

questions.question: A straight road and the lines marking its lanes are ___.
questions.explanation: Lane markings run alongside and never cross the road — they are parallel.

questions.question: How many line segments are there in a triangle?
questions.explanation: A triangle has 3 sides, each of which is a line segment.
